BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Van Werven, Klippert, Caldier, Short, Buys, Wilson, Hargrove, Haler, Zeiger, and Shea
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning human rights commission rules on gender segregated facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the human rights commission's rule-making authority; and adding a new section to chapter 49.60 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 49.60 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The human rights commission shall repeal the rule currently codified at WAC 162-32-060 in its entirety. The human rights commission may not thereafter initiate any rule-making procedure that involves the subject of gender segregated facilities.
